We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: burglary/ theft of electric cable from university. The act: breaking into warehouse, using tools, stealing cable valued 44,660 RMB. That's theft (盗窃) with breaking and entering, possibly "入室盗窃" (burglary). In Chinese criminal law, "盗窃罪" covers theft. If using force to break into a building, could be "入室盗窃罪" which is a specific form of theft. The examples: many similar theft cases labeled "盗窃". For example, the case with "张某某" stealing trees labeled "盗窃;非法狩猎". The case with "胡某某" is theft. Also there is "破坏生产经营" for damage, but here they stole cable, not just damage. So crime: 盗窃. Possibly also "破坏财物"? But theft includes damage. The examples: "故意毁坏财物" used when damage without theft. Here they broke window to enter, but primary crime is theft. So answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.
